entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This is the first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of regular bail.

The applicant has been arrested in connection with Crime No. 286 of 2024, registered at Police Station Kharsia, District Raigarh, Chhattisgarh for the offence under Sections 376(2), 376(2)(n)) of IPC and Section 6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: VEDPRAKASH DEWANGAN 2.

The case of prosecution in brief is that, on 15.05.2024, the mother of the victim lodged a written report against the applicant that her minor daughter was being sexually exploited by the applicant and he committed rape upon her since 14.05.2023.
The offence has been registered against the applicant and he has been arrested on 15.05.2024 and the charge sheet has been filed.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the report has been lodged by the mother,
which is highly belated.
The victim was the consenting party and has not made any complaint or objection to anyone while she was making physical relation with the applicant.
The applicant is in jail since 15.05.2024 and final adjudication of the case will take its own time.
Therefore, he may be enlarged on bail.

entities.text: Kanhu Urf Kanhaiya Das Mahant vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: On the other hand, learned counsel for the State opposes and has submitted that the present applicant is the maternal uncle of the victim.
She was being sexually exploited by the applicant since 14.05.2023 till 15.05.2024 and when her mother came into knowledge of the fact, she lodged the report.
From the material collected during the investigation, the victim appears to be aged about 13 years and 11 months.
Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case, the applicant is not entitled for bail.
5. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the documents annexed with the application.

6. Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the parties, considering the nature of the allegation and the material collected during the investigation, further considering the age of the victim as well as the fact that the applicant is the maternal uncle of the victim, I am not inclined to release the applicant on bail.
7. According, the present bail application is rejected.

Sd/-
